name: io.github.CTRLRun/ctrlrun-mcp-operator
title: ctrlrun Operator
description: Answer ctrlrun approvals from an MCP client: list what is held, inspect it, grant or deny.

packageArguments.description: Serve the operator's own commands as MCP tools.

packageArguments.name: --stdio
packageArguments.description: Speak MCP on stdin and stdout, open no socket, and record each answer under the OS login of the person whose client launched this.

environmentVariables.name: CTRLRUN_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Path to the ctrlrun.yaml your agents run against. The store is found beside it.
